status: written before the code (F1 rule: vectors first)
phase: F1: one ledger per run at <scope>/.jos/replays/<run_>/ledger.jsonl (or the runtime run dir), entry kinds admit/start/receipt/pal/end/error, hash chaining, verify, meter. F2: seal signature, approval/derive/secret_read/crystal/message kinds, replay modes.
description: Cases operate on ledger files the harness produces by running documents, plus hand-written ledgers for tampering. Both engines MUST agree on verify(), meter() and on the entries they write (masked: ts, run_, cap_, hashes recomputed by the harness).

entry_shape.hash: sha256 of the canonical entry with hash = ""

cases.name: one-run-writes-one-ledger
cases.note: §3 one ledger per run; order of kinds for an atom

cases.name: entry-hash-rule

expect.value: <sha256 of the JCS of this object with hash "" — harness computes with an independent serializer; both engines MUST match it>

cases.note: §2 hashing rule; same as SPEC-2.0 §7.2 receipts (C3)

cases.name: broken-prev-detected
args: <ledger with entry 3 prev pointing to entry 1>

cases.name: truncated-tail-detected
args: <ledger of hello run without its last line>
cases.note: a run that ended MUST have an `end` entry; a missing tail is reported

cases.name: receipt-entry-matches-result
cases.note: the receipt in result.receipts[] and the `receipt` entry body are the same object

cases.name: retry-writes-one-receipt-per-attempt
args: <document with retries 2 that fails every time>

cases.name: deny-is-ledgered
args: <document whose avoid matches its own run>
cases.note: an avoid hit still produces a receipt (code 3) and an end

cases.name: pal-entries-no-secrets
args: <document that reads jos://storage/fixtures/data.txt and writes jos://storage/out/x>
cases.note: §3 values never appear; only canonical URI and blob_

cases.name: append-only-no-rewrite
cases.note: a second run never modifies the first run's ledger

cases.name: meter-derivable
args: <ledger of a run with 2 shell attempts>
cases.note: §5 pure function; unreported meters are null

cases.name: meter-rejects-unverified
cases.note: metering a ledger that does not verify is an error, not a number

deferred.group: seal.json with ed25519 signature; verify of the seal
replay modes verify/deterministic/full and divergence report
entry kinds approval, derive, secret_read, crystal, message, kill
crystallized directory run with zero engine starts
